title: Strip resourceVersion before branching in v2 dashboard saves
answers: Why does saving a new v2 dashboard fail when resourceVersion is set?
Should v2 dashboard saves include resourceVersion?
Where should dashboard save metadata be sanitized?
body:
Symptom: Saving a new v2 dashboard fails when the supplied metadata includes resourceVersion.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard/api/v2.ts:K8sDashboardV2API.saveDashboard stripped resourceVersion only in the update branch, leaving it in create requests.
Fix pattern: Remove metadata.resourceVersion from the outgoing object before branching between create and update, so both save paths receive sanitized metadata.
Constraints: Applies to both create and update through the v2 dashboard save API; this does not establish a rule for other resource APIs.
applies: Changes to outgoing metadata in K8sDashboardV2API.saveDashboard, including saves with caller-supplied Kubernetes metadata.
